content:
ops-bot: ALERT 6881234567 — elevated 5xx rate observed from eu-dedicated pool (hostgroup: eu-ded-3). Affected customer: ArborTrust (enterprise tenant id: arb-7421). Paging oncall. :rotating_light:
ryan_oncall: on it. checking metrics and recent deploys. starting an incident thread here.
sanjay_infra: i'm seeing CPU saturation on gpus in eu-ded-3 around 06:14 UTC, OOMs on a subset of pods. rolling metric: pod_restarts +15% in last 2m.
ryan_oncall: thanks. can we scale up the pool? alex_eng, any recent rollout on the model variant serving ArborTrust?
alex_eng: no model rollout in last 24h. there's a spike in prefix-cache miss rate for long-chat sessions though — looks like larger seq lengths from ArborTrust workloads.
ryan_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) scale eu-ded-3 by +2 instances (sanjay), 2) enable fallback routing to eu-ded-1 (lower latency but different HW) for ArborTrust only, 3) limit max tokens per request to 2048 for affected routes until stable. initiating now.
sanjay_infra: scaling +2 requested to autoscaler, ETA ~90s. applying targeted routing rule for tenant arb-7421 to fall back to eu-ded-1 (non-disruptive).
liz_cs: Heads up — ArborTrust support contacts: primary: emma@arbortrust.com, backup: ops@arbortrust.com, account exec: julia-sales. They're high priority and want a tailored update.
marta_pm: please capture customer-facing impact statement. we need a short status page blurb and an email template we can send to ArborTrust within 30m.
ryan_oncall: status page draft below, please review quickly:
```
Status: Degraded service — We are investigating increased error rates affecting some requests for ArborTrust customers in the EU region. Impact: some API calls may return 5xx errors or experience increased latency. Mitigation: requests are being routed to alternate capacity and capacity is being scaled. We will provide updates every 30 minutes until resolved.
```
liz_cs: good. here's a short tailored message for ArborTrust outreach (editable):
```
Subject: Incident impacting ArborTrust — temporary degraded API responses in EU
Hi Emma / ArborTrust team — we are currently investigating elevated error rates impacting some API calls for your EU-hosted endpoints. Our engineers are routing requests to alternate capacity and scaling resources. You may see intermittent 5xx errors or higher latency for a limited subset of requests. Next update in 30 minutes or upon change. If you need immediate help, reply here or contact our on-call at +1-555-0123.
```
alex_eng: routing change completed, arb-7421 now preferentially hitting eu-ded-1. observed immediate drop in 5xx from ~18%->6% for the tenant in logs.
ryan_oncall: autoscaler started new instances, pods healthy. continuing to monitor; do not close incident until 30m stable and 5xx <1%.
sanjay_infra: noted. enabling temporary token-limit rule for arb-7421 routes. will rollback after stability check.
liz_cs: I'll prep the email and send to ArborTrust with ack & link to status page. tagging julia-sales so execs are in loop. :email:
marta_pm: prepare a short internal ops blurb for sales + CSMs: "ArborTrust EU: degraded -> routed to fallback; capacity scaled; customer notified; monitoring for 30m."
oncall-handoff-bot: ONCALL HANDOFF scheduled: ryan_oncall -> marta_pm at 08:00 UTC if incident persists. please ensure notes are in incident doc.
ryan_oncall: logging final notes: root cause suspected traffic pattern causing cache pressure + GPU OOMs. mitigations: routing to eu-ded-1, scale +2, token limit for tenant. next check 06:44 UTC.
liz_cs: message sent to ArborTrust with link to status page. will update when they acknowledge. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: UPDATE 6881234567 — 06:40 UTC: error rate for ArborTrust down to 0.8% over 5m window. continuing monitoring.
ryan_oncall: leaving this thread now, handoff scheduled to marta_pm for watch. copying runbook link: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/tenant-fallback-routing
